lines.en: label toukaarchery20:
scene toukatsuneyoarchery1
I, once again, take it upon myself to intrude on Wakana’s domain in an effort to get closer to a girl who may one day own this entire city.
lines.zh: 我又一次自做主张闯进 Wakana 的地盘，想借此接近一个「有朝一日可能坐拥这座城」的女孩。

lines.en: She is joined, of course, by a girl who will likely never own anything apart from the most popular ramen shop in the entire old district (Out of what I can only assume is one.)
lines.zh: 当然，陪她的是另一个女孩——她多半永远不会拥有任何东西，除了老城区最火的那家拉面店（我猜也就这么一家）。

lines.en: And while they are certainly an odd pairing, they’re not without their similarities as well.
lines.zh: 虽说她俩确实是对奇怪的组合，但也不是毫无共同点。

lines.en: They both grew up sheltered. Neither one of them is good at socializing. And they could probably kill me within a matter of minutes if they wanted to.
lines.zh: 两人都被保护着长大。都不擅长社交。而且只要想，大概几分钟内就能要了我的命。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery2
: Ha!
Or seconds in Tsuneyo’s case. Touka’s team of assassins (That I definitely know she has) would probably take a little longer to properly coordinate.
lines.zh: 换 Tsuneyo 是几秒就搞定。Touka 的刺客小队（我绝对确定她有）协调起来大概要多花点时间。

lines.en: : Almost there, Tsuneyo! Though, I can’t help but wonder if your shots would be any more accurate if you’d put less power behind them.
lines.zh: : 就差一点了，Tsuneyo！不过我不禁在想，你要是少使点劲，是不是能射得更准。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery3
: Weapons were made for inflicting harm. Normally upon other people with weapons.
lines.zh: : 武器生来就是为了造成伤害的。通常是伤害别的持武器的人。

lines.en: : But in this case, my enemy is a circle. And so I will attack with every last bit of power I have.
lines.zh: : 但此刻，我的敌人是一个圆。所以我会倾尽全力出击。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery4
: I am Tsuneyo Tojo, slayer of shapes!
lines.zh: : 我是 Tsuneyo Tojo，『形状屠夫』！

lines.en: : Ha!
scene toukatsuneyoarchery5
: Oh my. That one managed to pierce straight through the wall.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。这一箭直接射穿了墙。

lines.en: : The wall is my enemy as well.
lines.zh: : 墙也是我的敌人。

lines.en: : Please don’t go destroying school property in front of me. I think I’m supposed to report it or something.
lines.zh: : 请别当着我的面毁坏学校财物。我想我该上报之类的。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery6
: Oh, Sensei. Good morning. I was unaware you’d be joining us today.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei。早上好。我不知道你今天也来。

lines.en: : But I suppose I should have expected it on account of your newfound affinity for stalking me at my morning practices.
lines.zh: : 不过，看在你最近迷上了「偷看我晨练」的份上，我本该料到的。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I apologize. Did you not recently come here to watch me, only to subsequently spend the day with my mother and then proceed to forget about me entirely?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你前阵子不是特地跑来看我，结果转头跟我母亲混了一天，然后把我忘得一干二净吗？

lines.en: : I did. But why do you sound so bitter about this?
lines.zh: : 是有这事。可你干嘛这么酸溜溜的？

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery7
: The heart of a woman is a complicated thing. But the heart of a warrior is easy to understand. Shoot. Kill. Repeat.
lines.zh: : 女人的心很复杂。但武士的心很好懂。射。杀。重复。

lines.en: : Take aim at the shape before you...then steel your resolve and turn it into a tree.
lines.zh: : 瞄准眼前的形状……然后下定决心，把它变成一棵树。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery8
: Ha!
: It hit the wall again, didn’t it?
lines.zh: : 又射墙上了，对吧？

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery9
: Perhaps it is time for me to review the basics once more.
lines.zh: : 也许是时候让我重温一下基本功了。

lines.en: : Excellent idea, Tsuneyo. Why don’t you go have Miss Watabe teach you once more so I can spend the morning reminding our dear teacher to stop getting involved in my mother’s affairs?
lines.zh: : 好主意，Tsuneyo。你去找 Watabe 老师再教你一遍吧，我好利用这个上午，提醒我们亲爱的老师别再插手我母亲的事。

lines.en: : Yes, Master.
lines.zh: : 是，主人。

lines.en: : And please stop calling me “Master.” Even if I do enjoy the sound of it.
lines.zh: : 还有，请别再叫我「主人」。尽管我确实爱听。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery10
Tsuneyo scans her surroundings to make sure the coast is clear before collecting her arrows (Or at least the few that didn't break) at the opposite end of the archery range.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 环顾四周确认没人，才去弓道场另一头收她的箭（至少是那几支没断的）。

lines.en: Back on this side, however, it appears that I am in trouble?
lines.zh: 不过在这头，我好像惹上麻烦了？

lines.en: : Well? Do you have anything to say to me?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你就没什么要跟我说的？

lines.en: : You...look very pretty today?
lines.zh: : 你……今天真好看？

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery11
: Something I am not already aware of?
lines.zh: : 说点我还不知道的？

lines.en: : Are you...looking for an apology or something? What’s going on here?
lines.zh: : 你是……想要我道歉还是怎样？这到底怎么回事？

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery12
: That’s what I would like to know. Why are you suddenly so...gung-ho in terms of watching my morning practices? You hardly seem like the type to enjoy this sport.
lines.zh: : 这也正是我想知道的。你为什么突然这么……热衷来看我的晨练？你可不像是喜欢这项运动的人。

lines.en: : Are you only saying that because I'm a commoner?
lines.zh: : 你这么说是因为我是平民吗？

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery13
: Yes.

: But also because, at least from my perspective, it appears that your key interests are limited to flirting with the girls in class. And surely you wouldn’t flirt with me while there are sharp objects around.
lines.zh: : 但也因为，至少在我看来，你的主要兴趣似乎仅限于跟班上女孩调情。而且周围有利器的时候，你肯定不会跟我调情。

lines.en: On second thought, maybe Touka’s team of assassins is closer than I previously believed.
lines.zh: 转念一想，Touka 的刺客小队可能比我以为的更近。

lines.en: : It would be one thing if you were to take an interest in kyudo, but any woman in my position would be reasonably put off by someone coming to just watch for no reason at all.
lines.zh: : 你要是对弓道产生了兴趣倒也罢了，可站在我这位置的女性，对「无缘无故跑来看」的人，都会有合理的反感。

lines.en: : It seems unfair that your mom is allowed to but I’m not.
lines.zh: : 你妈能来我就不能来，这不公平。

lines.en: : My mother carried me inside of her body for nine months and then proceeded to nurture me afterward. Comparing yourself to her is just silly.
lines.zh: : 我母亲怀了我九个月，然后又把我抚养长大。你跟她比，太可笑了。

lines.en: : Fine. I guess I’ll just have to carry you around for nine months to make up for lost time. Come here, I’ll give you a ride back to the main building.
lines.zh: : 行。那我只能把你揣九个月，补上失去的时光了。过来，我背你回主楼。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery14
: What do you want, Sensei? And why can’t it wait until I’m not in the middle of morning practice? Disrupting one’s schedule for your own personal gain is exceptionally rude.
lines.zh: : 你想要什么，Sensei？而且干嘛非得趁我晨练的时候说？为了私利打乱别人的日程，是极其无礼的。

lines.en: : I’m glad you asked, Tsuneyo. Because there’s something I’ve been wanting to talk to you about and now is the best time for me.
lines.zh: : 你问到点子上了，Tsuneyo。因为正有件事我一直想跟你谈，而现在正是最佳时机。

lines.en: : Sorry, are you talking to me? Because Tsuneyo is still collecting her arrows and my name is Touka. To-u-ka. Say it with me. To-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你是在跟我说话吗？因为 Tsuneyo 还在收箭，而我叫 Touka。To-u-ka。跟我念。To——

lines.en: : Come on, Tsuneyo. Let’s talk in the shade.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Tsuneyo。我们去阴凉处谈。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery15
: ...Yes. Let’s do that.
lines.zh: : ……好。就去那儿。

lines.en: scene black
I convince Tsuneyo 2 to follow me behind the archery building so the two of us can talk without worrying about any rogue arrows or the possibility of being spotted with one another.
lines.zh: 我说服了「Tsuneyo 二号」跟我到弓道场楼后面，这样我们俩就能谈事而不用担心冷箭、或被人撞见我们在一起。

lines.en: Not because I think anyone would assume something, but because there actually is something I want to talk to Touka about and I don’t want to risk being interrupted.
lines.zh: 倒不是怕别人多想，而是我确实有件事要跟 Touka 谈，不想冒险被打断。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery16
But before that, I should try and clear up whatever misunderstanding she very obviously has about her mother and me.
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，我得先澄清她对她母亲和我之间那个明摆着的误会。

lines.en: : Just so you know, I haven’t boned your mom.
lines.zh: : 先说清楚，我没跟你妈上过床。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery17
There. That should take care of it. Now I can move on to-
lines.zh: 好了。这下应该没事了。现在我可以接着——

lines.en: : Why would you open the conversation like that? That was perhaps the worst possible way to get me to pay any attention to whatever it is you want to discuss today — which is apparently my mother.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛用这句话开场？这大概是让我「根本没心思听你今天想谈什么」的最烂方式了——而你今天想谈的显然是我母亲。

lines.en: : It’s not. Well, it is. Kind of. But I only opened like that because you’re clearly upset about me hanging out with her here and that is unfair to me — a man who came to here to see you.
lines.zh: : 不是。好吧，是。算是。可我那么开场，只是因为你显然对「我在这儿跟她厮混」不满，而那对我不公平——我可是专程来看你的。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery18
: I believe you. But that doesn’t change the fact that she is now caught up and interested in both your personal affairs and mine.
lines.zh: : 我信你。可这改变不了：她现在既插手、又对你的私事和我的私事都来了兴致。

lines.en: : I thought you wanted her to be more interested in your “personal affairs” though? What with the two of you barely ever seeing each other and everything.
lines.zh: : 可你不是希望她更关注你的「私事」吗？你们俩明明几乎见不着面。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery19
: Yes, but not like this. The ordeal with the apartment complex was meant to be something I handle on my own to show her I’m capable of taking on additional responsibilities.
lines.zh: : 是，但不该是这种方式。公寓楼那摊子事，本该由我独自处理，好向她证明我有能力承担更多责任。

lines.en: : Now, I’m being slowly pushed out of my own purchase all because she’s incapable of keeping her hands clean from anything that interests her. Which just so happens to be real estate and project management.
lines.zh: : 可现在，我正被一点点挤出自己的这笔「购置」，全怪她对任何让她感兴趣的事都做不到袖手旁观。而这次恰好是房地产和项目管理。

lines.en: : No offense to you or your mom, but those are some pretty boring interests.
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯你和你妈，但那两个兴趣可真够无聊的。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery20
: To you, I’m sure. But people love what they love. And my mother has a hard time letting things go once she becomes absorbed in them.
lines.zh: : 对你来说是无聊。可爱就是爱。而我母亲一旦扎进什么事里，就很难撒手。

lines.en: : I’m not sure how it happened this time, exactly-
lines.zh: : 我不太确定这次具体是怎么发生的——

lines.en: : But seeing as you just so happen to be the only resident of my complex and have been spending time with my mother recently, you can’t blame me for assuming you have something to do with this.
lines.zh: : 但既然你恰好是我那栋楼里唯一的住户、最近又在跟我母亲来往，你也别怪我怀疑这事跟你有关系。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery21
: I mean...I won’t say I don’t have anything to do with it. But I wish she’d stay out of this just as much as you do.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我不能说跟它一点关系没有。但我跟你一样，也希望她别插手这事。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery22
: You do? Why? I was under the impression the two of you were working together to some extent. Did I misunderstand?
lines.zh: : 你也希望？为什么？我还以为你们俩在某种程度上是一伙的。是我误会了？

lines.en: : Probably. In fact, the only reason she’s “working” with me at all is because I can do something she can’t.
lines.zh: : 多半是吧。其实，她肯跟我「合作」，唯一的原因是我能做到一件她做不到的事。

lines.en: : Well, yes. That’s the only reason partnerships exist in the first place. There’d be no reason to work together on something one could accomplish on their own.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是。这本来就是「合作」存在的唯一理由。一个人能独自完成的事，根本没必要合作。

lines.en: : But, and I apologize for how offensive this may sound, I highly doubt there is anything you can do that my mother can not.
lines.zh: : 不过——恕这话可能有点冒犯——我很难相信有什么是你能做到、而我母亲做不到的。

lines.en: : It’s something that involves Chika.
lines.zh: : 是一件跟 Chika 有关的事。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery23
: Chika? How did she get wrapped up in all of this? I was unaware you were even telling anyone about the building.
lines.zh: : Chika？她怎么也卷进来了？我都不知道你在跟别人提那栋楼的事。

lines.en: : Has Tsubasa really not told you anything?
lines.zh: : Tsubasa 真什么都没告诉你？

lines.en: : Not really, no. She did mention something about a plan for leasing the remaining rooms out, but I’m not privy to the specifics.
lines.zh: : 基本没有。她提过一句「把剩下的房间租出去的计划」，但具体的我不知情。

lines.en: : And seeing as the complex is technically owned by the Tsukioka Foundation and not specifically me, my hands are tied. She can do whatever she wants with this listing and I can’t stop her.
lines.zh: : 而且既然那栋楼严格说归月冈财团、不归我个人，我就被捆住了手脚。她想拿这处房产干嘛都行，我拦不住。

lines.en: : I actually don’t even have to be informed. So, unless she goes out of her way to specifically advise me of her plans, I’ll remain in the dark altogether.
lines.zh: : 其实我甚至不必被告知。所以，除非她特意来知会我她的计划，不然我就一直被蒙在鼓里。

lines.en: : Can I advise you of her plans? Or will you go and tell her that I came clean right away and destroy the rapport I have with her?
lines.zh: : 那我把她的计划告诉你，行不行？还是你会转头就去告诉她我全招了，毁掉我好不容易跟她建立的关系？

lines.en: : Is there any particular reason you need to continue building a rapport with her?
lines.zh: : 你有什么非得继续跟她搞好关系的理由吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But I can’t tell you what it is until you’re older.
lines.zh: : 有。但在你长大之前，我不能告诉你是什么。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery24
: You’re a disgusting man. You do know this, right?
lines.zh: : 你真是个恶心的男人。你知道吧？

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery25
: Yeah. Just wait until you hear the rest, though.
lines.zh: : 知道。不过等你听完剩下的，再下结论。

lines.en: : Like I said, the reason Tsubasa is suddenly so interested in this building isn’t because of me at all. It’s because of Chika and her sister.
lines.zh: : 我说了，Tsubasa 突然对这栋楼感兴趣，根本不是因为我。是因为 Chika 和她妹妹。

lines.en: : Your mom is unhappy with the condition of the building they’re living in-
lines.zh: : 你母亲不满意她们住的那栋楼的状况——

lines.en: : And for good reason. That apartment is held together by duct tape and Elmer’s glue.
lines.zh: : 而且不满意得有道理。那间公寓全靠胶带和白乳胶撑着。

lines.en: : But Chika doesn’t want to leave it since all of her childhood memories are there.
lines.zh: : 可 Chika 不想搬，因为她所有的童年回忆都在那儿。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery26
: I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: : So now, there’s this huge plan where I’m supposed to convince Chika to move into the building. But it came out of nowhere and I feel like I can’t even get out of it because Tsubasa’s too...commanding.
lines.zh: : 所以现在搞出这么个「大计划」：让我去说服 Chika 搬进那栋楼。可这完全是凭空冒出来的，而我觉得我连脱身都办不到，因为 Tsubasa 太……强势了。

lines.en: : May I ask why you want to get out of it?
lines.zh: : 我能问问你为什么想脱身吗？

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery27
: There’s more than enough room in that building for Chika. And I’d allow them to stay free of charge as I’m aware of Chinami’s condition and know that tragedy could strike at any moment.
lines.zh: : 那栋楼给 Chika 住绰绰有余。而且我愿意免费让她们住——我知道 Chinami 的身体状况，也知道悲剧随时可能发生。

lines.en: : The closer she is to adequate care, the safer she’ll-
lines.zh: : 她离像样的照顾越近，就越安全——

lines.en: : Chika...kind of thinks that we’re dating.
lines.zh: : Chika……有点以为我们在交往。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery28
: And...why does she think that, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那……她到底为什么会那么以为？

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : If I ask her to come live in the same building as me, it’ll turn into a whole thing. Like, yeah, I could probably make it happen under the guise of it all being real, but-
lines.zh: : 要是我请她来跟我住同一栋楼，就会变成一大摊事。我是说，是，我多半能在「假装这一切是真的」的幌子下办成，但——

lines.en: : How long has she thought this, exactly?
lines.zh: : 她这么以为，到底有多久了？

lines.en: : Long?
lines.zh: : 很久了？

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery29
: ...Yeah.
: And you never bothered clearing things up with her?
lines.zh: : 而你从没想过跟她把话说清楚？

lines.en: : No...and it’s kind of too late at this point, so...
lines.zh: : 没有……而且到这地步也有点太迟了，所以……

lines.en: : I’ve sort of just...accepted it.
lines.zh: : 我就……算是认命了。

lines.en: : I suddenly understand your resistance.
lines.zh: : 我突然明白你为什么抗拒了。

lines.en: : If Chika remains distant from you, it will be easier to continue shying away from the true nature of your relationship and what that means to you as opposed to what it means to her.
lines.zh: : 只要 Chika 跟你保持距离，你就更容易继续回避你们关系的真实性质——以及那对你意味着什么、对她又意味着什么。

lines.en: : And...just based on what I’ve seen and heard...would likely prevent her from questioning you in the event that others who may think the same thing she does wind up in that building as well.
lines.zh: : 而且……就凭我的所见所闻……这样多半还能防止她起疑——万一将来也有别的「跟她想的一样」的人搬进那栋楼的话。

lines.en: : People like Maya. Or Makoto.
lines.zh: : 比如 Maya。或者 Makoto。

lines.en: : Did Makoto tell you?
lines.zh: : 是 Makoto 告诉你的？

lines.en: : Not directly. But it wasn’t hard to pick up on once the two of us started growing closer.
lines.zh: : 不是她直接说的。不过自从我俩走近之后，这事不难察觉。

lines.en: : Gotcha....that’s basically the situation, then. And I feel weird talking to you about it like this, but I really just don’t know what else I’m supposed to do.
lines.zh: : 明白了……那基本就是这么个情况。跟你这么谈这事我觉得挺别扭，可我真不知道还能怎么办了。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery30
: Do you at least understand how I feel having to be the one to talk about this with you?
lines.zh: : 你至少明白「非得由我来跟你谈这个」是什么感受吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太明白。

lines.en: : Of course you don’t. Because it is more convenient for you to not understand that. Plus, you are an idiot.
lines.zh: : 你当然不明白。因为「不明白」对你更方便。再说，你是个白痴。

lines.en: : But instead of spelling it out for you, I’ll play my part and offer you a piece of advice instead.
lines.zh: : 不过，与其跟你掰开揉碎讲，我不如尽我的本分，给你条建议。

lines.en: : If that is okay with you, of course. I could just keep my mouth closed and let you sort this out with my mother. But good luck trying to get her to cease fire in any regard whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你愿意听。我也可以闭嘴、让你自己去跟我母亲掰扯。不过，想让她「停火」，祝你好运。

lines.en: : What do you think I should do?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我该怎么办？

lines.en: : You’re not going to like it. I will warn you right now. Do you still want to hear it regardless?
lines.zh: : 你不会爱听的。我现在就警告你。你还要听吗？

lines.en: : It’s not like I’ve got any other ideas. And, like you said, the chances of me getting Tsubasa to back down are slim to none.
lines.zh: : 反正我也没别的办法。而且，就像你说的，我让 Tsubasa 收手的希望渺茫到几乎为零。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery31
: I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Then, I think you need to grow up.
lines.zh: : 那么，我觉得你需要长大。

lines.en: : There are far greater problems in this world than whether or not you break the heart of a girl in the springtime of her youth.
lines.zh: : 这世上远比「会不会伤了一个正值青春的女孩的心」严重得多的问题，有的是。

lines.en: : You’re an adult and you should act like one. Which means having a backbone and making your own decisions instead of waiting for everyone else to change and mold every given situation to fit your needs.
lines.zh: : 你是个成年人，就该有个成年人的样子。也就是说，得有骨气、自己拿主意，而不是干等着别人去改变、把每个局面都掰成适合你的样子。

lines.en: : The fact of the matter is, Chika and her sister will be safer in a new housing complex.
lines.zh: : 事实是，Chika 和她妹妹住进新楼会更安全。

lines.en: : Will that make your life harder and a bit less convenient? Yes. But I ask you to think of how much better it will make their lives since you apparently haven’t done that of your own volition just yet.
lines.zh: : 这会让你的日子更难过、更不方便吗？会。但请你想想这会让她们的日子好过多少——既然你显然还没主动这么想过。

lines.en: : I’m not sure I follow. Getting Chika to move in wouldn’t require breaking her heart. It would be the exact opposite. Asking her to come live there would make her extremely happy.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白。让 Chika 搬进来并不需要伤她的心。恰恰相反。请她来住，她会高兴坏了。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery32
: At first, yes.
lines.zh: : 一开始，是会。

lines.en: : But how would she feel the moment she sees someone else leaving your room? That’s what you’re afraid of, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可等她看见别人从你房间里出来，她会是什么感受？这才是你怕的，不是吗？

lines.en: : No matter how secretive you be, she’ll always be right down the hall. And she could catch you at any moment.
lines.zh: : 无论你多隐秘，她都永远就在走廊那头。她随时可能撞见你。

lines.en: : I haven’t even...done anything like that in the apartment, though.
lines.zh: : 可我……还没在公寓里干过那种事。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery33
: Then gaining a few new neighbors wouldn’t disrupt your habits at all. It would just prevent new ones from forming. Which, in this context, sounds like it could be a good thing.
lines.zh: : 那多几个新邻居根本不会打乱你的习惯。只会防止你养成新的坏习惯。放在这个语境下，听着反倒是好事。

lines.en: : I told you you wouldn’t like what I had to say. Every last bit of it makes your life worse and everyone else’s life better. That is essentially a narcissist’s Kryptonite.
lines.zh: : 我说了你不爱听。我说的每一条都让你的日子更糟、别人的日子更好。这基本上就是自恋者的「氪石」。

lines.en: : Did I say that correctly? Kryptonite? That’s the superhero gem, right?
lines.zh: : 我说对了吗？氪石？就是超人的那种宝石，对吧？

lines.en: : You know, you really do take after your mom.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你真的很像你妈。

lines.en: : Because I’m beautiful and smart?
lines.zh: : 因为我们都又美又聪明？

lines.en: : Sure, there are those things. But it’s mostly because you’ve both found a way to put yourself on a pedestal miles above everyone else without seeming entirely pompous about it.
lines.zh: : 当然，也有这方面。但主要是因为，你们俩都有本事把自己架到比别人高好几英里的神坛上，又不显得全然的傲慢。

lines.en: : Generosity goes a long way in bringing people over to one’s side. You should try it some time.
lines.zh: : 「慷慨」最能收买人心。你有空也该试试。

lines.en: scene toukatsuneyoarchery34
: Sounds exhausting.
lines.zh: : 听着就累。

lines.en: : Oh...you don’t know the half of it...
lines.zh: : 哦……你还只是知道个皮毛……

lines.en: scene black
As I leave the archery range, I feel a little bad about emptying my problems out all over Touka.
lines.zh: 离开弓道场时，我有点愧疚，不该把自己的烂摊子全倒给 Touka。

lines.en: But, for the sake of creating another fun new comparison that may or may not be symbolic in some sort of way, I will now do several things.
lines.zh: 不过，为了再整一个「可能有、也可能没有象征意义」的新鲜对比，我现在要做几件事。

lines.en: The first of which is having you imagine that my problems are a liquid.
lines.zh: 第一，让你把我的烦恼想象成一种液体。

lines.en: The second is recalling what I said moments ago about how similar Touka and her mother are.
lines.zh: 第二，回想我刚才说过的「Touka 和她母亲有多像」。

lines.en: The third is forgetting that.
lines.zh: 第三，忘掉那点。

lines.en: And the fourth is wrapping back around to my liquid problems and finalizing the comparison by telling you Tsubasa’s skin is hydrophobic.
lines.zh: 第四，绕回我那「液体烦恼」，收尾这个对比——告诉你：Tsubasa 的皮肤是「疏水」的。

lines.en: Her daughter’s is not.
lines.zh: 她女儿的不是。

lines.en: $ toukaarchery20 = True
$ touka_love += 1
Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!
lines.zh: Touka 的好感度上升到了 [touka_love]！

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
